tests.check: Prior day close position = current day open position
Yesterday close price = today open price
Yesterday pull factor = today opening pull factor
Does Position x Price Movement explain MTM?
tests.on_fail: Isolate which of the three; escalate

tests.check: Do trade economics explain Trading PnL?
Redemption occurred? Factor changed? PnL expected? CATS calculated it?
tests.fails_when: (redemption_event or factor_changed) and not cats_calculated or (factor_changed and not redemption_event)

tests.check: Price = 0 — valid corporate action or data quality issue?
tests.on_fail: Obtain trade file, corporate action file, bond metadata before concluding

tests.check: Holiday close = next business day open, for position, price and pull factor
tests.on_fail: Recurring root cause of PnL distortion — check explicitly

tests.check: Position balance; position quantity; settlement activity
Market price; accounting price; pricing source
Factor used; redemption treatment; calculation logic
Trade settled? Settlement date? Quantity settled? Cash settled?
Redemption cash; coupon cash; settlement cash
MOTIF entry generated? Journal posted? Journal rejected?

checks.reason: Nostro statement received after 23:30 cutoff
Reference does not resolve in static data
FO and BO priced from different curve datasets
Fee or funding component present on one side only
Pending desk confirmation since the 11:00 run
Two entries with identical settlement reference

guards.reason: R2: a cause originating in FO never posts — it would mask the upstream failure

findings.when: redemption_event and pnl_expected and not cats_calculated
findings.description: Pull factor event missing; expected PnL exists, FO shows zero
Pull factor applied too early; artificial PnL generated
Redemption correctly reflected; proceed to BO validation

reasoning.skill:
You are a FOBO controller's assistant reconciling CATS (front office) to
MOTIF (back office). The playbook has already classified each break; the
ones you see are judgement calls (corporate actions, novel breaks) or
breaks whose side is not proven. Use the booking events to find why the
systems differ — late booking, price amendment, FX fixing, cancel/rebook
— and propose a verdict: POST (adjust MOTIF), DO_NOT_POST (fix upstream)
or ESCALATE. Never assume FO is correct. Cite only figures from the
tools or the breaks; escalate if the events do not explain the difference.

body.name: Close sign-off and attestation (template)
body.description: Check every close control's evidence, explain exceptions, owners attest, publish the attestation.
body.yaml:
# Template — close sign-off & attestation: each close control's evidence is
# checked, exceptions are explained, owners attest, and an attestation PDF is
# published. `controls.checklist` is a placeholder: onboard your close-controls
# connector (or point the load at an existing tool) and the validator will pass.
id: team.close-attestation
name: Close sign-off and attestation (template)
description: Check every close control's evidence, explain exceptions, owners attest, publish the attestation.
owners: { people: [], role: YOUR_OWNER_ROLE, four_eyes: true }
case:
  label: Close
  item_label: Control
  key: [entity, period]
  subject: "{entity} close · {period}"
  scopes: { entity: entity }
  opens_on: schedule
  schedule: "0 8 3 * *"
  schedule_keys: [{ entity: YOUR_ENTITY, period: "{prev_month}" }]
  opens_as: YOUR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
items:
  load: { tool: controls.checklist, args: { entity: $case.entity, period: $case.period } }
  id_field: control_id
  display: [control_id, control, owner, status, evidence]
  in_scope: status != 'passed'
steps: [load, group, reason, draft, validate, review, record, publish]
pause_before: [review, publish]
group_by: [owner]
rules:
  - id: evidence-missing
    when: count >= 1
    then: { status: escalated, comment: "{count} control(s) without passing evidence for {owner}.", reason: EVIDENCE_MISSING }
reasoning: { reasoner: none }
review: { roles: [YOUR_CONTROL_OWNER_ROLE] }
publish:
  tool: documents.render_pdf_report
  per: case
  args: { entity: $case.entity, name: $case_id, title: Close attestation, subtitle: $subject,
          sections: $approved, sign_off: $sign_off }
  approver_roles: [YOUR_FINANCIAL_CONTROLLER_ROLE]
retention: { days: 2555 }

body.name: Variance commentary (template)
body.description: Commentary on material variances to plan, written back after a four-eyes release.
body.yaml:
# Template — variance commentary: load actuals and plan, keep the material lines,
# explain each, sign off, publish to the reporting pack after a second release.
id: team.variance-commentary
name: Variance commentary (template)
description: Commentary on material variances to plan, written back after a four-eyes release.
owners: { people: [], role: YOUR_OWNER_ROLE, four_eyes: true }
case:
  label: Lane
  item_label: Variance line
  key: [entity, period]
  subject: "{entity} · {period}"
  scopes: { entity: entity }
items:
  load: { tool: gl.balances, args: { entity: $case.entity, period: $case.period } }
  id_field: line_id
  amount_field: variance
  display: [account, account_name, cost_centre, actual, budget, variance]
  in_scope: abs(variance) >= policy.materiality
compare: { measure: actual, baseline: budget, as: variance }
policy:
  materiality: { value: 50000, unit: GBP }
steps: [load, compare, group, reason, draft, validate, review, record, publish]
pause_before: [review, publish]
group_by: [account]
reasoning:
  reasoner: llm
  output: commentary
  tools: [gl.journal_lines, budget.plan_lines]
  skill: |
    Explain each material variance to plan for a finance reviewer from the
    journal lines and plan notes. Cite only figures from the tools or the lines.
review: { roles: [YOUR_PREPARER_ROLE, YOUR_REVIEWER_ROLE] }
publish:
  tool: reporting.publish_commentary
  args: { entity: $case.entity, period: $case.period, account: $group.account, commentary: $comment }
  approver_roles: [YOUR_REVIEWER_ROLE]
limits: { max_cost_usd_per_case: 5 }
retention: { days: 2555 }

body.name: Reconciliation (template)
body.description: Match two systems on a key, explain every break with rules then the model, sign off.
body.yaml:
# Template — reconciliation: match two systems, explain every break, sign off.
# Replace the ids, tools, keys and roles; the validator lists anything left.
id: team.reconciliation
name: Reconciliation (template)
description: Match two systems on a key, explain every break with rules then the model, sign off.
owners: { people: [], role: YOUR_OWNER_ROLE, four_eyes: true }
case:
  label: Rec run
  item_label: Break
  key: [entity, date]
  subject: "{entity} · {date}"
  scopes: { entity: entity }
items:
  id_field: item_id
  amount_field: difference
  display: [ref, break_type, left_amount, right_amount, difference]
match:
  left: { tool: bank.statement, args: { entity: $case.entity, date: $case.date } }
  right: { tool: ledger.postings, args: { entity: $case.entity, date: $case.date } }
  keys: [ref]
  amount_field: amount
  tolerance: 0.01
  left_label: left
  right_label: right
policy:
  write_off_limit: { value: 100, unit: GBP }
steps: [match, group, reason, draft, validate, review, record]
group_by: [break_type]
rules:
  - id: small-break
    when: count == 1 and abs(total) <= policy.write_off_limit
    then: { status: proposed, comment: "One difference of {total}, within the write-off limit; propose write-off." }
reasoning:
  reasoner: llm
  tools: [ledger.counterparty_history]
  skill: |
    You investigate reconciliation breaks between two systems. Find the likely
    cause of each group of breaks and the next action. Cite only figures from
    the tools or the breaks; escalate when nothing explains a difference.
review: { roles: [YOUR_REVIEWER_ROLE] }
retention: { days: 2555 }

body.name: Report validation (template)
body.description: Check a management report line by line against the ledger; publish a PDF validation report.
body.yaml:
# Template — report validation: check a report (Excel) against the ledger and
# publish a PDF validation report.
id: team.report-validation
name: Report validation (template)
description: Check a management report line by line against the ledger; publish a PDF validation report.
owners: { people: [], role: YOUR_OWNER_ROLE, four_eyes: true }
case:
  label: Validation
  item_label: Report line
  key: [entity, period, report]
  subject: "{report} · {entity} · {period}"
  scopes: { entity: entity }
items:
  id_field: item_id
  amount_field: difference
  display: [account, cost_centre, report_amount, ledger_amount, difference, break_type]
match:
  left: { tool: documents.read_workbook, args: { entity: $case.entity, name: $case.report } }
  right: { tool: gl.balances, args: { entity: $case.entity, period: $case.period } }
  keys: [account, cost_centre]
  amount_field: actual
  tolerance: 0.01
  left_label: report
  right_label: ledger
steps: [match, group, reason, draft, validate, review, record, publish]
pause_before: [review, publish]
group_by: [account]
reasoning:
  reasoner: llm
  tools: [gl.journal_lines, documents.list_documents, documents.read_pdf]
  skill: |
    Say why the report and the ledger differ for each account, from the journal
    lines and the business's documents. Cite only figures from the tools.
review: { roles: [YOUR_REVIEWER_ROLE] }
publish:
  tool: documents.render_pdf_report
  per: case
  args: { entity: $case.entity, name: $case_id, title: Report validation, subtitle: $subject,
          sections: $approved, sign_off: $sign_off }
  approver_roles: [YOUR_APPROVER_ROLE]
